LanguageData.LootScavenging_UnfamiliarInspect: Unfamiliar technology: cannot be equipped or worn until its research is finished.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_UnfamiliarInspectNoResear: Unfamiliar technology: cannot be equipped or worn until your colony reaches its tech level.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_RecycleDescription: Recycle {0} into raw materials of its era.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_StudyNow: Can be studied now for {0}, with a study bill at a research bench.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_BulkBillNote: Does ten bills' work in one job, and starts only when at least {0} units are on hand.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_StudyDescription: Study {0} for research points toward the current project. Each bill uses up to {1} units, each worth {2} points, and takes longer the more points it pays. The bill waits when the project cannot take this scrap. "Do until you have X" keeps X units in stock.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_StudyWhyNoPoints: Cannot be studied: this scrap is worth no research points.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_StudyWhyNoProject: Cannot be studied now: no research project is selected.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_StudyWhySpecialSource: Cannot be studied for {0}: that project is learned another way.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_StudyWhyFinished: Cannot be studied now: {0} is already complete.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_StudyWhyPrerequisites: Cannot be studied for {0}: its prerequisites are not finished.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_StudyWhyTechprints: Cannot be studied for {0}: its techprints have not all been applied.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_StudyWhyColonyEra: Cannot be studied yet: the colony has not reached the {0} era.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_StudyWhyProjectEra: Cannot be studied for {0}: it is a {1} project, above {2} scrap.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_StudyWhyNoGain: Cannot be studied now: the storyteller's research speed is zero.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_StudyWhyNoBench: Cannot be studied now: no research bench on this map can research {0}.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_StudyWhyNotWorth: Cannot be studied now: this item is no longer unfamiliar.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_StudyWhyTooLittle: Cannot be studied now: {0} needs too few points to be worth using up this item.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_RecycleOriginalDescriptio: Break down one unfamiliar item as if it were the scrap it would have become: the same yield. Tick the items you are willing to use up; none are ticked by default.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_StudyOriginalDescription: Study one unfamiliar item for research points as if it were the scrap it would have become: the same points. Tick the items you are willing to use up; none are ticked by default. An item is left alone when the project needs less than half its worth.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_PresetChangedExplain: Some settings no longer match the {0} preset. Pick a preset to set every setting back to its values. The keep and remove lists stay as they are.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_LockedReason: Locked by the modpack: this setting always uses the pack's value, so it cannot be changed here.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_LockedSummary: Some settings are locked by the modpack. They stay at the pack's values whichever preset you pick.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_PresetProgressionExplain: Hostile, non-hostile and wild pawns, the colony's prisoners and recruited prisoners: their weapons and apparel beyond your research become scrap, and everything else drops as normal. Other joiners keep their gear, with gear beyond your research marked unfamiliar. Nobody drops their gear when downed or killed, and corpses are left.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_PresetCleanupExplain: Ignores research. From hostile pawns only, weapons below normal quality, apparel below good quality and either one below 50% hit points are deleted, and so is all their ammunition; the rest drops as normal. Every hostile humanlike corpse is removed.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_PresetVanillaExplain: Every group is left alone and everyone drops their gear when downed or killed, so loot and corpses behave as in the base game.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_ResetConfirm: Set every setting back to its default (the Progression preset) and empty the keep and remove lists?
LanguageData.LootScavenging_HomeMapOnly: Apply on the home map only
LanguageData.LootScavenging_HomeMapOnlyOn: Loot on caravan, quest and outpost maps is left alone.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_HomeMapOnlyOff: The rules apply on every map.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_ColonistsKeepGearOn: A downed colonist or colony slave keeps their weapon in hand and their inventory, also when carried, rescued or loaded from a save. A dead one keeps them on the body. Colony gear never goes through the item rules.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_ColonistsKeepGearOff: A downed or dead colonist drops their weapon and inventory, as in the base game. Colony gear never goes through the item rules.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_HostilesKeepGearOn: A downed hostile keeps their weapon in hand and their inventory, also when carried. A dead one keeps everything on the body until the corpse is stripped, butchered or cremated.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_HostilesKeepGearOff: A downed or dead hostile drops their weapon and inventory, as in the base game, and what drops follows the item rules as it drops.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_NonHostilesKeepGearOn: Pawns of non-hostile factions and wild people: a downed one keeps their weapon in hand and their inventory, and a dead one keeps everything on the body.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_NonHostilesKeepGearOff: A downed or dead non-hostile or wild pawn drops their weapon and inventory, as in the base game, and what drops follows the item rules as it drops.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_KeepGearExplain: These boxes choose where gear lands; the Who rows below choose whether it follows the item rules. Mechanoids and other pawns that cannot be stripped still drop on the ground.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_WhoHostileApply: Gear that comes off hostile pawns, such as raiders, when they are downed or killed follows the item rules below.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_WhoHostileExclude: Gear of hostile pawns is left alone.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_WhoNonHostileApply: Gear that comes off pawns of non-hostile factions, such as traders and visitors, follows the item rules below.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_WhoNonHostileExclude: Gear of pawns of non-hostile factions is left alone.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_WhoWildApply: Gear of wild people follows the item rules below, and wild animal corpses can be removed.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_WhoWildExclude: Wild people and animals are left alone, gear and corpses both.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_WhoPrisonersApply: Gear that comes off a prisoner follows the item rules below: when a prisoner is stripped, or when a standing pawn is arrested.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_WhoPrisonersExclude: Gear that comes off a prisoner drops whole, as in the base game.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_WhoRecruitedPrisonersAppl: As they join, their worn apparel, held weapon and inventory follow the item rules, as if they were stripped.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_WhoRecruitedPrisonersExcl: Their gear is not touched as they join.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_WhoOtherJoinersApply: As wanderers, refugees and quest joiners join, their worn apparel, held weapon and inventory follow the item rules, as if they were stripped.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_WhoOtherJoinersExclude: The gear of wanderers, refugees and quest joiners is not touched as they join.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_WhoMarkExplain: Their gear drops whole. Gear beyond your research is marked unfamiliar and cannot be used until its research is finished; it can be recycled or studied like scrap. The item rules are not used for this group.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_WhoJoinMarkExplain: They keep wearing and holding what they came with, and keep their inventory. Gear beyond your research, in the inventory too, is marked, and once it comes off, no colonist can use it until the research is finished.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_NoGroupOn: Every group is set to Leave alone, so the item rules change no loot and no corpses.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_ItemsNote: These rules decide what happens to gear from groups set to Apply item rules.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_DisassemblyEfficiency: Disassembly efficiency, % (shared by every disassemble rule)
LanguageData.LootScavenging_LimitHitPoints: Only below a hit point level
LanguageData.LootScavenging_RuleKeep: {0} from affected pawns drop as normal.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_RuleActChance: {0} from affected pawns {1} {4} of the time. Otherwise they drop as normal.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_RuleActQuality: {0} from affected pawns {1} when below {2} quality. Otherwise they drop as normal.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_RuleActQualityChance: {0} from affected pawns {1} when below {2} quality {4} of the time. Otherwise they drop as normal.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_RuleActHitPoints: {0} from affected pawns {1} when below {3} hit points. Otherwise they drop as normal.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_RuleActHitPointsChance: {0} from affected pawns {1} when below {3} hit points {4} of the time. Otherwise they drop as normal.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_RuleActQualityOrHitPoints: {0} from affected pawns {1} when below {2} quality or below {3} hit points. Otherwise they drop as normal.
{0} from affected pawns {1} when below {2} quality or below {3} hit points {4} of the time. Otherwise they drop as normal.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_RuleActReach: {0} from affected pawns {1} when beyond your research. Otherwise they drop as normal.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_RuleActReachChance: {0} from affected pawns {1} when beyond your research {4} of the time. Otherwise they drop as normal.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_RuleActReachQuality: {0} from affected pawns {1} when beyond your research and below {2} quality. Otherwise they drop as normal.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_RuleActReachQualityChance: {0} from affected pawns {1} when beyond your research and below {2} quality {4} of the time. Otherwise they drop as normal.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_RuleActReachHitPoints: {0} from affected pawns {1} when beyond your research and below {3} hit points. Otherwise they drop as normal.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_RuleActReachHitPointsChan: {0} from affected pawns {1} when beyond your research and below {3} hit points {4} of the time. Otherwise they drop as normal.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_RuleActReachQualityOrHitP: {0} from affected pawns {1} when beyond your research and below {2} quality or below {3} hit points. Otherwise they drop as normal.
{0} from affected pawns {1} when beyond your research and below {2} quality or below {3} hit points {4} of the time. Otherwise they drop as normal.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_VerbDisassembleEra: are broken on the spot into materials typical of the colony's era
LanguageData.LootScavenging_VerbDisassembleItem: are broken on the spot into {0} of their own ingredients
LanguageData.LootScavenging_OneOrTheOtherExplain: Each unit of scrap is either recycled for materials or studied for research.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_StudyThenRecycleExplain: Studied scrap is not used up: what is left can be recycled afterwards, at reduced value.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_StudyPointsPerTier: Research points per unit, by era
LanguageData.LootScavenging_StudyPointsPerTierExplain: Set an era to 0 and its scrap cannot be studied. Scrap above the colony's era waits until the colony advances.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_StudyPointsHalvedNote: Scrap was made cheaper in 0.5.2, so your research points per unit were halved to keep the same total.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_ScrapValuePerTier: Scrap market value per unit, by era
LanguageData.LootScavenging_ScrapValuePerTierExplain: Stockpiled scrap counts toward colony wealth and can be sold at this value. A low value keeps a stockpile from raising colony wealth.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_YieldEraExplain: Disassembled gear gives materials picked from the colony era's recycling pool, so a tribal colony does not get plasteel on the battlefield.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_YieldItemExplain: Disassembled gear gives back part of what it was made from, at the efficiency set beside each disassemble rule.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_TechprintProjectsOn: Study pays into projects that need techprints, even before the techprints are applied. It stops one point short until they are.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_TechprintProjectsOff: Projects that still need techprints receive nothing from study.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_UnfamiliarAllExplain: Any gear beyond your research is unfamiliar, wherever it came from. That includes your colony's own starting gear, since your colonists don't know how to use it yet, and gear bought from traders or given as a quest reward.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_UnfamiliarLootedExplain: Only gear that came off pawns is unfamiliar. Gear bought from traders or given as a quest reward can be used.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_UnfamiliarAllExplainUnuse: Any gear beyond your research is unfamiliar, wherever it came from. That includes your colony's own starting gear, since your colonists don't know how to use it yet, and gear bought from traders or given as a quest reward. Only used for groups set to Mark unfamiliar.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_UnfamiliarLootedExplainUn: Only gear that came off pawns is unfamiliar. Gear bought from traders or given as a quest reward can be used. Only used for groups set to Mark unfamiliar.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_CorpseHumanlikeOn: Corpses of people from groups set to Apply item rules or Mark unfamiliar are removed after their gear has been sorted.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_CorpseAnimalOn: Animal corpses from groups set to Apply item rules or Mark unfamiliar are removed. Wild animals only count while wild people and animals are set to Apply item rules or Mark unfamiliar.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_CorpseAnimalOff: Animal corpses are left, for food or leather.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_CorpseMechanoidOn: Mechanoid corpses from groups set to Apply item rules or Mark unfamiliar are removed.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_CorpseMechanoidOff: Mechanoid corpses are left, for smelting.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_ButcherExplain: Butchering a humanlike corpse strips it first, and what comes off follows the item rules under its owner's row. The corpse of a group set to Leave alone, or a colonist's, is butchered as in the base game.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_ProtectQuestOn: Items tied to a quest are never touched.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_ProtectQuestOff: Items tied to a quest follow the rules like any other.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_ProtectUniqueOff: Unique weapons follow the rules like any other.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_ProtectPersonaOff: Persona weapons follow the rules like any other.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_ProtectRelicsOff: Relics follow the rules like any other.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_KeepListExplain: Items on this list are never touched, whatever the other rules say. This list wins over the remove list.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_RemoveListExplain: Items on this list skip their rule's conditions and chance. They get their category's outcome, or are deleted when that outcome is Drop as normal.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_ListAddExplain: Opens a search over every loaded item. Entries are kept by name, so an item from a removed mod stays listed and works again if the mod returns.
LanguageData.LootScavenging_PickerFirstShown: Showing the first {0} of {1} items. Type more to narrow the search.
